Name: Farmer's Notebook
Author: laparlinha
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Farmer's Notebook[/b][/size]
[i]An in-game planner, calendar, guide and journal for Stardew Valley 1.6[/i][/center]
[line]

[font=sans-serif]Farmer's Notebook puts useful information from your current save and Stardew Valley's game data into an in-game notebook, so you can keep track of your farm without leaving the game.[/font]

[font=sans-serif][b]Press N to open the notebook.[/b][/font]

[list]
[*][font=sans-serif]❤️ [b]Today[/b]: daily events, weather, luck, birthdays, crops and fishing information[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]🔮 [b]Upcoming[/b]: the next three days, including events, tasks and harvests[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]🗓️ [b]Calendar[/b]: full seasonal calendar with events and crop information[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]📚 [b]Guide[/b]: forageables, fish, Community Center bundles, Museum donations and tailoring[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]⭐ [b]Goals[/b]: long-term goals you want to keep visible[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]✅ [b]Tasks[/b]: one-time, daily and weekly reminders[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]🗒️ [b]Notes[/b]: free-form notes and lists[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]📜 [b]Journal[/b]: automatic history of completed tasks, goals and farm milestones[/font][/*]
[/list][line]

[font=sans-serif][size=5][b]📖 In-Game Notebook Item[/b][/size][/font]

[font=sans-serif]The Farmer's Notebook is also available as a physical item in-game. It arrives by mail with a short welcome letter. If you lose it, you can have another one mailed from the config menu.[/font]

[font=sans-serif]The notebook menu can always be opened with [b]N[/b]. If you prefer, hold the physical notebook and use the action button to open it instead. This is also useful for controller players who do not want to assign a keyboard shortcut.[/font]

[font=sans-serif]If you lose the item, [b]Resend Notebook By Mail[/b] is available in Generic Mod Config Menu.[/font]

[line]

[font=sans-serif][size=5][b]✨ Notebook Interface[/b][/size][/font]

[list]
[*][font=sans-serif]Leather cover and spiral-bound design[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]Colored bookmark tabs for each section[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]Decorative stickers and page illustrations[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]Save-specific layouts and data that persist between sessions[/font][/*]
[/list]
[font=sans-serif]The first time you open the notebook each in-game day, a short opening animation plays. Later openings that day open directly to the current page.[/font]

[line]

[font=sans-serif][size=5][b]❤️ Today[/b][/size][/font]

[font=sans-serif][b]Fortune & Weather[/b][/font]

[font=sans-serif]Today's luck and tomorrow's weather.[/font]

[font=sans-serif][b]Calendar Events[/b][/font]

[font=sans-serif]Birthdays, festivals, Traveling Merchant, Book Seller and other seasonal events. Information is read directly from the game's data.[/font]

[font=sans-serif][b]Birthday Gift Suggestions[/b][/font]

[font=sans-serif]Click a birthday to see the villager's portrait and loved, liked and disliked gifts, including item sprites and tooltips.[/font]

[font=sans-serif][b]Planting Recommendations[/b][/font]

[font=sans-serif]Crops are grouped by how useful it is to plant them at the current point in the season:[/font]

[list]
[*][font=sans-serif][b]Tier A[/b]: multiple harvests are possible before the season ends[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif][b]Tier B[/b]: time-sensitive; plant now or the harvest window may be missed[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif][b]Tier C[/b]: the crop will not mature before the season ends[/font][/*]
[/list]
[font=sans-serif]Click a crop to create a planting task.[/font]

[font=sans-serif][b]Fishing Alert[/b][/font]

[font=sans-serif]Shows how many fish species are currently in season and highlights rain-dependent fish. Detailed locations and time windows are available in the Guide.[/font]

[line]

[font=sans-serif][size=5][b]🌾 Harvest Forecast[/b][/size][/font]

[font=sans-serif]Tracks planted crops on the Farm, in the Greenhouse and on Ginger Island.[/font]

[list]
[*][font=sans-serif]Crops ready to harvest today[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]Growing crops and days remaining[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]Expected harvest count for multi-harvest crops[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]Crop sprites for identification[/font][/*]
[/list]
[font=sans-serif]Crops that are not ready today are included in the Upcoming forecast.[/font]

[line]

[font=sans-serif][size=5][b]🔮 Upcoming[/b][/size][/font]

[font=sans-serif]Shows the next three days, grouped as [i]Tomorrow[/i], [i]In 2 days[/i] and [i]In 3 days[/i].[/font]

[font=sans-serif]Includes birthdays and gift suggestions, festivals, merchant visits, seasonal reminders, scheduled tasks and upcoming harvests. Season changes and the end of the year are handled automatically.[/font]

[line]

[font=sans-serif][size=5][b]🗓️ Calendar[/b][/size][/font]

[font=sans-serif]A full calendar covering all four seasons, with two views.[/font]

[font=sans-serif][b]Events[/b]: birthdays, festivals, merchant visits, passive seasonal events and task counts.[/font]

[font=sans-serif][b]Crops[/b]: the last day each crop can be planted in the selected season, plus expected harvest dates for crops already planted.[/font]

[font=sans-serif]Move between seasons freely and click a date to see the full list of events and tasks for that day.[/font]

[line]

[font=sans-serif][size=5][b]📚 Guide[/b][/size][/font]

[font=sans-serif][b]Forageables[/b][/font]

[font=sans-serif]Seasonal forageables with information about where each item can be found.[/font]

[font=sans-serif][b]Fish[/b][/font]

[font=sans-serif]Seasonal availability, locations, rain requirements and time windows. Hover over a fish to see how many you have caught and your size record.[/font]

[font=sans-serif][b]Community Center[/b][/font]

[font=sans-serif]Shows incomplete bundles, required items and remaining quantities. The tracker becomes available after you meet the Junimos, matching the game's progression. A setting can be enabled if you prefer to see bundles earlier.[/font]

[font=sans-serif][b]Museum Donations[/b][/font]

[font=sans-serif]New in v3.9.0. Tracks items that can be donated to Gunther, grouped into Artifacts, Minerals and Other. Undiscovered items remain mystery silhouettes until you have found them. Donated items show their name, description and sale price.[/font]

[font=sans-serif][b]Tailoring Log[/b][/font]

[font=sans-serif]New in v3.10.0. Tracks clothing made at the Sewing Machine, grouped into Hats, Shirts, Bottoms and Other, including the cloth and materials required. Only clothing you have crafted at least once is shown. The tab appears after you make your first clothing item.[/font]

[line]

[font=sans-serif][size=5][b]✅ Tasks[/b][/size][/font]

[font=sans-serif]Create three types of reminders:[/font]

[list]
[*][font=sans-serif][b]One-Time[/b]: scheduled for a specific date[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif][b]Daily[/b]: resets every morning[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif][b]Weekly[/b]: repeats on a selected weekday[/font][/*]
[/list]
[font=sans-serif]Missed tasks move to an [b]Overdue[/b] section. Planting tasks can be created directly from crop recommendations, including the crop icon.[/font]

[font=sans-serif]The dedicated Tasks tab lists open tasks chronologically up to three years ahead. Daily and Weekly tasks have separate groups, while one-time tasks are grouped by year.[/font]

[line]

[font=sans-serif][size=5][b]⭐ Goals[/b][/size][/font]

[font=sans-serif]Track long-term goals such as completing the Community Center, reaching a skill level, building a structure or catching a legendary fish.[/font]

[font=sans-serif]Up to three goals can be pinned and shown at the top of the notebook. Completed goals can be marked as finished.[/font]

[line]

[font=sans-serif][size=5][b]📜 Journal[/b][/size][/font]

[font=sans-serif]The Journal automatically records completed tasks, completed goals and certain farm milestones, including first catches and first monster kills.[/font]

[font=sans-serif]Entries include the season, day and year and are grouped by date, newest first.[/font]

[line]

[font=sans-serif][size=5][b]📤 Export[/b][/size][/font]

[font=sans-serif]New in v3.7.0. Export your Journal, Notes, Goals and completed Tasks as a self-contained HTML page styled like the notebook.[/font]

[font=sans-serif]Enable [b]Export data[/b] in Generic Mod Config Menu and go to sleep. The export is created the following morning after the save has been written.[/font]

[font=sans-serif]The HTML file is saved next to your save folder using your farm name and a timestamp, so previous exports are not overwritten. It can be opened in any browser and printed or saved as PDF using the browser's print function.[/font]

[font=sans-serif][b]Mobile:[/b] The export feature has not been tested on Android/mobile. The file should be usable in a mobile browser, but the file-location and printing instructions assume desktop use.[/font]

[line]

[font=sans-serif][size=5][b]🗒️ Notes[/b][/size][/font]

[font=sans-serif]A free-form scratchpad for information that does not belong on a calendar or task list.[/font]

[font=sans-serif]You can create up to 20 notes, with up to 2000 characters per note. Each note has its own decorative sticker.[/font]

[line]

[font=sans-serif][size=5][b]🌍 Localization[/b][/size][/font]

[font=sans-serif]Farmer's Notebook follows the game's language setting.[/font]

[font=sans-serif]Currently available:[/font]

[list]
[*][font=sans-serif]🇬🇧 [b]English[/b][/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]🇧🇷 [b]Brazilian Portuguese[/b][/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]🇮🇹 [b]Italian[/b][/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]🇰🇷 [b]Korean[/b] (thanks to [b][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/jjongleee]jjongleee[/url][/b])[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]🇨🇳 [b]Simplified Chinese[/b] (thanks to [b][url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/118168688-wildstonehan1/]WildStone[/url][/b])[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]🇹🇼 [b]Traditional Chinese / Taiwan[/b] (thanks to [b][url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/194463848-jiawanshen/]jiawanshen[/url][/b])[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]🇯🇵 [b]Japanese[/b] (thanks to [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/OSHIKAWA]OSHIKAWA[/url][/b])[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]🇪🇸 [b]Spanish[/b] (thanks to [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Backtech]Backtech[/url][/b])[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]🇫🇷 [b]French[/b] (thanks to [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/vin163]vin163[/url][/b])[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]🇳🇱 [b]Dutch[/b] (translated by my daughter)[/font][/*]
[/list]
[font=sans-serif][b]Dutch:[/b] Stardew Valley does not include Dutch as a built-in selectable language. [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24290]Stardew Valley Dutch - V1.6[/url][/b] adds a proper [i]Nederlands[/i] button to the game's language menu. Once selected, Farmer's Notebook uses its [font=monospace]nl.json[/font] translation automatically.[/font]

[font=sans-serif]See the [i]i18n[/i] folder for the manual fallback instructions if you do not want to install the language pack.[/font]

[line]

[font=sans-serif][size=5][b]👥 Multiplayer[/b][/size][/font]

[font=sans-serif]Each farmer has their own notebook and separate data in multiplayer.[/font]

[list]
[*][font=sans-serif]Tasks, goals, journal entries and milestones are tracked per player[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]A task created by one player is not shown to other players[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]Each player's data is stored on their own computer[/font][/*]
[/list]
[font=sans-serif]Existing saves are updated automatically. Nothing is deleted; previous save-wide data remains in the save file as a backup.[/font]

[line]

[font=sans-serif][size=5][b]⚙️ Configuration[/b][/size][/font]

[font=sans-serif]Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for settings.[/font]

[list]
[*][font=sans-serif]Change the notebook hotkey (default: [b]N[/b])[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]Show or hide crops you have not discovered yet[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]Show or hide fish you have not caught yet[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]Set a minimum friendship level before birthdays and gift suggestions appear[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]Show Community Center bundles before unlocking the Community Center[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]Show Desert and Ginger Island forageables/fish before unlocking those areas[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]Choose how many Goals are pinned (1-3)[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]Resize the notebook (100-130%)[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]Export notebook data to HTML[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]Request another physical notebook item by mail[/font][/*]
[/list]
[line]

[font=sans-serif][size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size][/font]

[list]
[*][font=sans-serif]Stardew Valley 1.6[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]SMAPI 4.1.10 or later[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (optional)[/font][/*]
[/list]
[line]

[font=sans-serif][size=5][b]📦 Installation[/b][/size][/font]

[list=1]
[*][font=sans-serif]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] if you have not already.[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]Download Farmer's Notebook and extract the [font=monospace].zip[/font].[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]Place the [font=monospace]FarmersNotebook[/font] folder inside your [font=monospace]Mods[/font] folder.[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/font][/*]
[/list]
[code]
Stardew Valley/
└── Mods/
└── FarmersNotebook/
├── manifest.json
└── ...
[/code]
[font=sans-serif]Press [b]N[/b] in-game to open the notebook.[/font]

[line]

[font=sans-serif][size=5][b]🔄 Updating[/b][/size][/font]

[list=1]
[*][font=sans-serif]Delete the old [font=monospace]Mods/FarmersNotebook[/font] folder.[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]Install the new version.[/font][/*]
[*][font=sans-serif]Restore your [font=monospace]config.json[/font] if you want to keep your current settings.[/font][/*]
[/list]
[font=sans-serif][b]Settings:[/b] Deleting the mod folder resets GMCM settings such as the notebook key and zoom level.[/font]

[font=sans-serif][b]Save data:[/b] Tasks, goals, notes, journal entries and other notebook data are stored by SMAPI, not in the mod folder. Updating or deleting the mod folder does not delete this data.[/font]

[line]

[font=sans-serif][size=5][b]🗑️ Uninstalling[/b][/size][/font]

[font=sans-serif]Delete the [font=monospace]Mods/FarmersNotebook[/font] folder. If you still carry the notebook item, it turns into an Error Item once the mod is gone; you can simply trash it. No other cleanup is required.[/font]

[font=sans-serif]Your saved notebook data remains intact if you reinstall the mod later.[/font]

[line]

[font=sans-serif][size=5][b]❓ FAQ / Common Issues[/b][/size][/font]

[font=sans-serif][size=3][b][color=#e8a317]▶ The notebook does not open with N[/color][/b][/size][/font]

[font=sans-serif]Check for a hotkey conflict with another mod. You can change the key in Generic Mod Config Menu.[/font]

[font=sans-serif][size=3][b][color=#e8a317]▶ The Book Seller does not appear on the calendar[/color][/b][/size][/font]

[font=sans-serif]The Book Seller's visit days are read from game calendar data that is not always available. If the data cannot be found, the feature is skipped. Reloading the save usually fixes this.[/font]

[font=sans-serif][size=3][b][color=#e8a317]▶ A crop does not appear in the planting recommendations[/color][/b][/size][/font]

[font=sans-serif]Crops are read from the game's crop data, including crops added by content mods that use the standard format.[/font]

[font=sans-serif][size=3][b][color=#e8a317]▶ A known crop does not appear[/color][/b][/size][/font]

[font=sans-serif]If [i]Show unknown crops[/i] is disabled, only crops you have already encountered appear. Enable the option in GMCM to show all crops.[/font]

[font=sans-serif][size=3][b][color=#e8a317]▶ Birthday gifts do not appear[/color][/b][/size][/font]

[font=sans-serif]If a villager does not have gift information in the game's data, the gift section is hidden. The birthday itself is still shown.[/font]

[font=sans-serif][size=3][b][color=#e8a317]▶ A villager's birthday is missing[/color][/b][/size][/font]

[font=sans-serif]Check [i]Min. Friendship for Birthdays[/i] in GMCM. Set it to 0 to always show birthdays.[/font]

[font=sans-serif][size=3][b][color=#e8a317]▶ Desert or Ginger Island forageables/fish are missing[/color][/b][/size][/font]

[font=sans-serif]By default, these areas are shown after they are unlocked. Enable [i]Show Locked Regions[/i] in GMCM to see them earlier.[/font]

[font=sans-serif][size=3][b][color=#e8a317]▶ The Bundles tab is missing[/color][/b][/size][/font]

[font=sans-serif]The Bundles tab appears after you meet the Junimos. Enable [i]Show Bundles Before Community Center Unlock[/i] in GMCM if you want to see it earlier.[/font]

[font=sans-serif][size=3][b][color=#e8a317]▶ The Journal is empty[/color][/b][/size][/font]

[font=sans-serif]The Journal records activity from version 3.0 onward. Earlier completed tasks are not added retroactively.[/font]

[font=sans-serif][size=3][b][color=#e8a317]▶ The interface is in English despite my game language[/color][/b][/size][/font]

[font=sans-serif]Make sure the [font=monospace]i18n[/font] folder is present inside [font=monospace]Mods/FarmersNotebook[/font]. If it is missing, reinstall the complete mod folder from the archive.[/font]

[font=sans-serif][size=3][b][color=#e8a317]▶ Does Farmer's Notebook work with a controller?[/color][/b][/size][/font]

[font=sans-serif]Yes, with some limitations. You can open the notebook, move between tabs, select crops, check tasks, scroll pages and switch tabs with the left/right triggers. Text input for creating tasks, goals and notes still requires a keyboard.[/font]

[line]
